payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how section titles are incorporated into the BOS representation in the HiStruct+ model.

claims.text: Section titles are incorporated into the BOS representation by adding a Section Title Embedding (STE) or classified STE to the sentence representations when available.
The HiStruct+ model enriches sentence representations with hierarchical structure information, including section titles, which are encoded and injected into the TLM sentence representations.
